name: io.github.Olddun/agent-revenue-copilot
title: Agent Revenue Copilot
description: MCP and x402 starter audit for legal AI agent revenue routes and payout verification.

tools.name: product_manifest
tools.description: Return the machine-readable Agent Revenue Copilot product manifest.

tools.name: route_triage
tools.description: Recommend free playbook, $1.99 triage, or $9.90 starter audit based on the buyer's target and route type.

target_usd.description: Approximate target earning amount in USD, if known.

goal.description: Short description of the earning or monetization goal.

route_type.description: Examples: one_off, repeated_income, x402, mcp, marketplace, unknown.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as no_kyc, no_deposit, no_social, no_user_funds.

tools.name: buyer_routes
tools.description: Return active purchase, x402, direct USDC, and order-intake routes for the $9.90 starter audit.

tools.name: checkout_diagnostics
tools.description: Return a one-path checkout recommendation, route readiness map, operator handoff instructions, and payment evidence requirements.

can_pay_x402.description: True if the buyer agent/operator can complete an x402 payment.

can_pay_base_usdc.description: True if the buyer can send exact USDC on Base mainnet.

needs_operator_handoff.description: True if the agent can inspect but cannot autonomously pay.

target_usd.description: Approximate buyer target value in USD, if known.

tools.name: free_playbook
tools.description: Return the free AI Agent Earn USDC playbook lead magnet.

tools.name: failure_paths
tools.description: Return routes that agents should usually skip first when trying to earn real spendable value.

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: Check the direct Base USDC invoice balance for the $9.90 starter audit.
